title: Configure HTTP Security Headers with Helmet in Node.js
title_es: Configura headers de seguridad HTTP con Helmet en Node.js
description: Runnable Express app with Helmet 8 security headers (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CORS) plus a supertest suite that verifies each header.
description_es: App Express ejecutable con headers de seguridad de Helmet 8 (CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, CORS) más una suite supertest que verifica cada header.
